title: Define a RAG golden set
description: This cell defines a synthetic co-op corpus and questions that test retrievable facts and abstention.

steps.description: CORPUS stores four invented Markdown files about hours, membership, tools, and safety at a bicycle co-op.
Each golden entry contains a question, an evidence phrase, and the fact a correct answer must state. The final question has None values because the notes cannot answer it.

steps.question: How many golden questions have no evidence phrase in the notes?
steps.answer: One golden question has no evidence phrase.

steps.description: The cell prints 4 files, 6 golden questions, and 1 question the notes cannot answer.
